product_summary: Tiruppur (Tamil Nadu) 100% export-oriented knitwear/apparel + home-textile unit, est. 2010, claims 6 lakh garments/month. Real product lines from own site (indianarmourexports.com): (1) apparel — baby wear, kids wear, teen wear, mens wear, womens wear, masks; (2) baby textiles — muslin wraps, muslin diaper towels, baby changing pad, baby bumper, baby bib, baby nest; (3) kitchen linen — apron, glove (oven mitt), pot holder, kitchen towel, dish towel, tea cosy, bread basket; (4) table linen — table cloth, napkin, table mat/placemat, table runner; (5) living room — curtains, throws, filled cushions, mattress cushions, chair pads; (6) bedding & bathing — bed spreads, duvet sets (duvet cover + pillow covers), bath/terry towels, beach mats, hamam/beach towels; (7) bags & pouches — shopping bags, fruit bags, storage bags, laundry bags, makeup bags, pouches. Site also lists in-house dyeing, printing, label unit and garment unit (vertical composite).
role_hint: manufacturer (self-described 100% export-oriented manufacturer with own dyeing/printing/garment units; also names 'RTR Garments' and 'Faith Garments' as partnership companies in Tiruppur — possible group/associate structure, not a trader sign per se)
comment: HS 6217.10 ('other made-up clothing accessories') is only a partial fit. It legitimately covers the accessory-type items in the range — aprons, oven gloves/mitts, pot holders, tea cosies, bread-basket covers, masks (6217.10 / 6217.90 depending on knitted vs woven). But it does NOT cover the bulk of the declared business: the company's core is knitted readymade garments (Tirupur knitwear hub) which belong in Ch.61 (6109/6110/6111 for baby & knit tops/sweaters, 6111.20/6111.30 for cotton/synthetic babies' garments) and Ch.62 for woven garments (6209.20/6209.90 babies', 6211.42/6211.43 tracksuits & other garments). Home textiles are entirely missing from the declaration and are a major, explicitly listed line: bed linen 6302.21/6302.31, toilet/kitchen linen incl. terry towels 6302.60, other kitchen linen 6302.91, curtains 6303.92/6303.99, bedspreads 6304.19, cushions/duvet covers 6304.92/6304.99, table linen 6302.51/6302.53. Bags & pouches (shopping/laundry/makeup) would be 4202.22/4202.32 or 6307.90 depending on material. Industry field 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a clear MISCLASSIFICATION — the company is apparel/home-textile, no food or FMCG products appear anywhere on the site. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company is kept, declared code corrected to the actual range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product data is from the company's own website (indianarmourexports.com, Home/Home Textile/About pages) — no customs line or shipment record was checked in this HS-only pass, therefore the entire product range is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note also that the site's product pages render as the same single-page content (no separate per-product pages), so fibre composition (cotton vs MMF, knitted vs woven) is not published — the 6-digit split above is inferred from product type and Tirupur knitwear context, not from stated composition; exact codes need confirmation from the commercial invoice/packing list. No PAN, CIN or state registry data researched per role scope.
